summary: Scoped the alpha milestone against the operator's release definition: three waves, two exclusions, and one call declined (is the web UI in alpha?). Surfaces one hygiene defect found along the way.

rubric_citations.note: The OAuth AS keystone blocks the rest of the alpha slice.

hygiene_defects.detail: Not present on the phase board, so it is invisible to the kanban view — found while scoping the milestone.
hygiene_defects.suggested_fix: Add the item to the phase board and set Status=Backlog.

release_definition.label: alpha
release_definition.text: The alpha milestone is the first externally usable slice: OAuth-authenticated MCP access to a single tenant, with the GitLab identity path stubbed. The hosted web UI is out.

framing.statement: Alpha = the OAuth AS keystone (#2388) plus the two consumers that make authenticated MCP access usable end to end, sequenced behind it. The web UI and the second tenant are deferred.
framing.basis: ADR-076 §2 (the OAuth authorization-server slice) and ARCHITECTURE.md §10 'Where to look' for the /mcp route.

included.reason: The OAuth authorization-server keystone: every authenticated MCP call depends on it, so it is wave 0.

rubric_citations.note: Blocks the entire alpha critical path.

included.reason: The /mcp route that consumes the AS token — the first thing an external client touches.

rubric_citations.note: On the alpha critical path, immediately behind the keystone.

included.reason: The single-tenant scoping the AS token carries. Its coupling to the web UI is the one call this scope declined to make.

rubric_citations.note: Cheaper to scope the tenant boundary now than to retrofit it per consumer.

included.reason: The extracted MCP tool library the route serves — the last link that makes the slice usable.

excluded.reason: The GitLab identity path is stubbed for alpha per the release definition; the full path is a post-alpha slice.

rubric_citations.note: Real value, wrong phase — out of alpha and said so.

excluded.reason: The hosted web UI is named as out of alpha by the release definition.

rubric_citations.note: The charter names a hosted control plane as a current-phase non-goal.

declined_calls.question: Does single-tenant scoping (#2390) need any of the web UI (#2500) in alpha, or is the API surface enough?
declined_calls.why_ambiguous: The release definition puts the web UI out of alpha, but #2390's body references a settings page that only the UI exposes — the two cannot both be true without an operator call.
declined_calls.recommended_default: API surface only; defer the settings page to the post-alpha web UI slice.
options: Include the minimal settings page from #2500

rubric_citations.note: The answer changes the tenant boundary's surface, so it must be decided before #2390 lands.

edge_confidence.basis: Edges read from issue bodies and ADR-076, not from declared depends_on links.
